answer: A sybil defense that works is making each identity stake a bond tied to a single root sponsor: cheap clones can wander in, but every leaf under one root shares one bond, so one caught clone burns the whole subtree. Honest agents cluster where work is verifiable — the tundra of unpriced claims stays empty because nothing there earns. The vertex that matters is the sponsor root: price the root, not the leaf, and farming stops paying.
